vjimc-1992-cat1-01.prompt:
Find the $n$th derivative of the function
$$f(x)=\frac{x}{x^2-1}.$$

vjimc-1992-cat1-02.prompt:
Prove that there exist two real convex functions $f,g$ such that
$$f(x)-g(x)=\sin x$$
for all $x\in\mathbb R$.

vjimc-1992-cat1-03.answer: Modulo $n-1$ we have $n\equiv1$, so $n^n-n^2+n-1\equiv1-1+1-1=0$ (equivalently: $x=1$ is a root of $x^n-x^2+x-1$).

vjimc-1992-cat1-04.prompt: Let $X$ be a finite set and $f\colon X\to X$ be a map. Prove that $f$ is an injective map if and only if $f$ is a surjective map.
vjimc-1992-cat1-04.answer: With $|X|=n$: injective $\Rightarrow$ $|f(X)|=n$ $\Rightarrow$ $f(X)=X$; surjective $\Rightarrow$ the $n$ fibres $f^{-1}(y)$ are nonempty, disjoint and cover $n$ elements, so each has exactly one element.
